title: Gujranwala Taj Campus, Gujranwala | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Gujranwala Taj Campus, located in Gujranwala, Pakistan. Address: 2nd Floor, Taj Islamic Research Center, Block-C, Magnolia Park, Near Jamia Masjid Taj, Gujranwala. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Gujranwala as the city.
